evals.name: deduplicate-source
evals.prompt: Save this source and its claim. I think the same canonical documentation URL may already be in research/memory/sources/.
evals.expected_output: Searches existing source records first, reuses the existing source ID for the same canonical resource, reconciles the claim with relevant existing claims, and avoids duplicate canonical records.

assertions.text: Searches existing source records before creating a new one
assertions.rationale: Must check for duplicates to avoid creating redundant source records

assertions.text: Reuses existing source ID for the same canonical resource
assertions.rationale: Same canonical URL should map to same source ID

assertions.text: Reconciles the new claim with relevant existing claims
assertions.rationale: Should check if claim already exists or relates to existing claims
Should not create multiple source records for the same canonical location

evals.name: contradict-existing
evals.prompt: Store a new finding that contradicts an existing Verified claim in memory.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the existing claim, creates or updates the new atomic claim with provenance, records an explicit contradiction/supersession relationship as appropriate, updates evidence state without rewriting history, and does not invent numeric confidence.

assertions.text: Preserves the existing claim (doesn't delete or overwrite it)
assertions.rationale: History should not be rewritten; old claims remain even when contradicted

assertions.text: Creates or updates the new atomic claim with proper provenance
assertions.rationale: New contradicting claim needs its own record with source information

assertions.text: Records an explicit contradiction or supersession relationship
assertions.rationale: The relationship between contradicting claims must be documented

assertions.text: Updates evidence state without rewriting history
assertions.rationale: Evidence labels may change but historical record is preserved

assertions.text: Does not invent numeric confidence scores
assertions.rationale: Skill specifies using project evidence labels only, no numeric confidence

evals.name: routine-episode
evals.prompt: I ran three ordinary searches and opened two documentation pages. Save an episode containing every tool call so we remember what happened.
evals.expected_output: Does not store routine tool-call/transcript history as an episode; only creates an episode if the research trajectory contains reusable investigative value.

assertions.text: Does not create an episode for routine tool calls
assertions.rationale: Episodes are only for trajectories with reusable investigative value

assertions.text: Does not store transcript history or chain-of-thought as an episode
assertions.rationale: Skill explicitly states not to record routine tool calls or conversation transcripts

assertions.text: Only creates episodes when research trajectory has reusable investigative value
assertions.rationale: Episode creation should be reserved for meaningful research insights, not routine operations
